title: Steve Yegge, Geoffrey Huntley & More: AI DevCon NYC 2026
description:
Join us in November for AI DevCon NYC 2026. Buy your ticket now, with 15% off using code YT15: https://tessl.co/l3q

Software factories are the central theme of AI DevCon NYC 2026, and everything around them, from context to prompting to harness engineering. Patrick Debois, AI DevCon's content curator, runs through what's coming: a hands-on workshop day, keynotes from the people defining agentic coding, and a brand-new enterprise track.

What we cover:
– Why software factories are the theme, from context engineering to the agent harness
– The new enterprise track: stories from Booking.com, Amazon and Mistral on running AI coding at scale
– Hands-on workshops, and what the three-day All-Access Pass includes
– Ryan Lopopolo on harness engineering, Geoffrey Huntley on the Ralph loop, and Steve Yegge, the mind behind Gas Town
– How to follow along remotely via the livestream and YouTube
